progression.narrative: The performance opens on C#4 and dwells most on D# in Moqaddame-ye Dad. The line peaks at F#4 (367.5 Hz) at 0:21.5. It closes on the tonic (D#4 → C#4 → B3 → D#4 → B3 → B3).
